quote: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation.description: Driver changes course from a direct course, including same-direction lane change
activation.source_clause: turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course

obligation.description: Give a continuous signal over the applicable final traveled distance before course change
obligation.source_clause: shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle

timing.description: Final traveled path distance; weather does not alter the duty

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original area class and complete sampled path distance must be established.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: during not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original other-area class and complete sampled path distance must be established.
Post-tick samples test sampled continuity; visible pixels and intersample behavior require review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: prior to changing the course of a vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original body/lane transition must establish actual course change independent of command.
Original precipitation source is retained; no weather waiver or changed threshold is inferred.
